svg.title: Same occupied state, different empty level
svg.desc: A fixed orthonormal two-orbital basis with two noninteracting electrons. H0 diag(-1,+1) eV, H1 diag(-1,+2) eV. The occupied orbital and density remain identical while the one-particle level gap changes from 2 to 3 eV. Not independent self-consistent DFT solutions or a Hohenberg-Kohn counterexample.
svg.metadata: {"type": "review teaching model", "basis": "fixed orthonormal phi0, phi1", "electrons": 2, "H0_eV": [[-1, 0], [0, 1]], "H1_eV": [[-1, 0], [0, 2]], "warning": "not independent self-consistent DFT solutions or a Hohenberg-Kohn counterexample"}
